## The question

What made me look at this?

## What I did

Enough information to understand or reproduce the test. This does not need to become a journal-style Methods section.

## What happened

Put the important figure, table or result here.

## What I think it means

Interpret the result. Separate observation from interpretation where that distinction matters.

## Caveats

What should a reader *not* conclude from this?

## Code / data / references

Links or citations if useful. Omit this section when it adds nothing.
